Search Lobbying Organization Names

eulob_search.Rd

Searches organization names in the bundled EU-LOB catalogue using configurable string-matching methods.

Usage

eulob_search(
  query,
  country = NULL,
  limit = 100L,
  data_dir = NULL,
  method = "cosine",
  min_similarity = NULL,
  q = 2L,
  p = 0.1
)

Arguments

query

Non-empty character string to search for.

country

Optional territorial code, such as `"ES"` or `"UE"`. Converted to uppercase before filtering.

limit

Positive whole number specifying the maximum number of returned rows. Default is `100L`.

data_dir

Must be `NULL`. External catalogue directories are not supported in this version.

method

Matching algorithm. One of `"cosine"` (default), `"jaccard"`, `"jw"`, `"dl"` or `"fixed"`.

min_similarity

Optional minimum similarity between 0 and 1. Default is `NULL`, meaning no threshold. Used only for approximate matching.

q

Positive integer specifying the character q-gram length for cosine and Jaccard similarity. Default is `2L`.

p

Jaro-Winkler prefix scaling factor between 0 and 0.25. Default is `0.1`. Used only with `method = "jw"`.

Value

A data frame containing:

name_id

Identifier associated with a normalized name.

name

Recorded organization name.

country

Territorial or register code.

register

Name of the source register.

lobby_id

Register-specific entry identifier.

similarity

Numeric similarity score between 0 and 1, included only for approximate matching methods.

Results are limited to the requested number of rows. If no rows satisfy the search criteria, an empty data frame with the corresponding columns is returned.

Details

The default method is cosine similarity using character bigrams (`method = "cosine", q = 2L`).

Approximate matching is implemented using the `stringdist` package. The available methods are:

- `"cosine"`: cosine similarity of character q-grams. - `"jaccard"`: Jaccard similarity of character q-grams. - `"jw"`: Jaro-Winkler similarity. - `"dl"`: Damerau-Levenshtein similarity. - `"fixed"`: case-insensitive literal substring matching.

Approximate methods return a similarity score between 0 and 1, where higher values indicate greater string similarity.

When `min_similarity = NULL`, no minimum similarity threshold is applied. Consequently, approximate methods may return low-scoring or unrelated results when no close match exists. A positive threshold can be specified to restrict the results.

The `"fixed"` method preserves the original substring-search behavior. It does not calculate similarity scores and ignores the approximate-matching parameters.

Results represent name-to-register-identifier relationships, not necessarily unique legal entities. The same organization name may appear in several registers.

Approximate results are ordered by decreasing similarity, followed by normalized name, territorial code and register identifier. Fixed results are ordered by normalized name, territorial code and register identifier.

Similarity is lexical rather than semantic. High similarity does not establish that two names refer to the same legal entity.

See also

[eulob_lobbies()], [eulob_countries()]

eulob_search("Siemens Mobilty", limit = 5)
